This open-source AI agent could potentially change the landscape for developers, providing them access to powerful coding tools without straining their budgets.

Following this successful recruitment strategy, Listen Labs recently announced a substantial funding round of $69 million, which will be used to further scale their operations and enhance their product offerings.
